san3.historicalAttributesHelp: Historical abilities stay in checkpoints. A fresh boot with only a native save restores disc defaults. Leadership changes recruitment capacity; existing troops are preserved.
san3.customAttributesHelp: Custom abilities are part of native game data. Save in the game after editing. Leadership changes recruitment capacity; existing troops are preserved.
san3.readonlyHelp: Unavailable in this state. Relationships and calculated totals are read-only.
san3.cityPriceHelp: Food rates are rice units per gold; equipment prices are gold per unit. Prices must remain positive for trading.
san3.presetSummary: The game adds {bonus} points; leave room to allocate all of them.
san3.presetHelp: Edit before entering ability allocation. These defaults stay in checkpoints while the registration module remains loaded; a cold boot or module reload restores disc defaults. Existing officers are unchanged.
san3.birthdayHelp: February permits 29 days; other months follow the game calendar.
san3.portraitHelp: Choose a portrait supported by this game. Unregistered slots stay unregistered; use the game to create an officer.
san3.lifespanHelp: Category 0–7 changes the age threshold for death checks; it is not an exact death age.
san3.actionCompleteHelp: Clearing this flag permits another strategic action. Assigned, dead or battling officers remain locked.
san3.serviceYearsHelp: With a former faction, both service counters must total 1–256 to avoid overflow when returning.
san3.kanjiHelp: Up to three characters from this game’s character set. Unchanged names keep their original bytes.
san3.kanaHelp: Up to seven encoded kana bytes; a voiced kana uses two. Hiragana and katakana are accepted.
